story.title: Food for the moments where tradition matters.
story.lead: The need is simple: when families gather, the food has to taste like home and still feel effortless to arrange. We make the familiar dishes, guide the portions, and keep the order path clear.
journey: Tell us guests, date, and dietary needs
We confirm the spread and service details
Food is prepared, packed, and served with care
events: Banana-leaf meals, biryani service, sweets, and a schedule that respects your ceremony.
Comfort dishes that travel well and feel familiar to elders, children, and guests.
Clear portions, labelled dietary choices, and food that arrives ready to serve.
A festive spread with crowd-pleasing starters, curries, rice, and sweets.
Takeaway favourites for evenings when only proper Tamil food will do.
